gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sen: Spaghetti-like strokes of Funnel Display all run the same width, loose and loud. Sen follows in a plain sans with tall lowercase and one steady line, so the pair holds together through shared simplicity.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sarpanch: Commanding Goldman spreads its letters wide, its round forms curving like open parentheses over a tight, compact Sarpanch. The mix of sprawl and snugness is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-ruda: Ruda reads like a thin wire bent into wide-mouthed rounds, with an x-height generous enough for screens. Grandstander adds bold, plain-lined heads above it, loud where Ruda stays slight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-savate: Savate has a sturdy hairline feel, with open jaws on every curve and a round o nearly as tall as a capital. Gugi's heading is bolder and odder, so a long page would still read smoothly.
gen-gf-offside-fs-bespoke-sans: Wide, level, and a bit aloof: Offside spaces its letters out and leaves its curves unclosed. Bespoke Sans is the sharper reader, with a high lowercase and generous gaps where curves meet stems, while Offside simply makes an entrance.
gen-gf-offside-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee has a glassy, neon-tube thickness and terminals that stop well clear of the stem. Offside does the loud entrance with wide, level letters, and ABeeZee does the settling in.
gen-gf-offside-gf-aldrich: Offside stretches its letters wide with curves that refuse to close, giving the heading a commanding, level beat. And Aldrich, a plain sans with a high x-height and cupped rounds, can be sized down a little for text.
gen-gf-offside-gf-alexandria: Alexandria reads tall and open, its c terminals wide and its stems short above and below. Alexandria would carry a long page smoothly, while Offside's wire-like monoline lettering stays up top, spaced wide and showy.
gen-gf-offside-gf-amiko: Amiko stands tall, its lowercase heavy as crayon marks and its terminals pointing outward like tongs. But Offside, with its single constant line width and wide spacing, gives the pair a stand-out sharpness.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-bangla: Approachable Anek Bangla sets wide s curves with a short stretch from midline to ascender, under Offside's thin-looking letters. And a longer passage in this sans would move along easily, with little to snag on.
